response.rationale: Both answers and the English sense are correct, but the relation overstates the variety split. Indonesian matang is well supported for ripe fruit, while Malaysian Malay masak is supported; however, Malaysian matang and Indonesian masak can also express this sense. Add an explicit shared-synonym/preference contrast. This is not a false-friend distinction.
